formula.source: MWELO (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 23, ch. 2.7): ETWU = ETo x 0.62 x [(PF x HA) / IE + SLA]. 0.62 converts inches over a square foot to gallons. Confirmed against city worksheets that reproduce the ordinance.

eto.station: Los Angeles (PLACEHOLDER, not the official row)
eto.source: Placeholder typical of coastal Los Angeles, entered from memory. The official MWELO Appendix A row for Los Angeles could not be retrieved in this build. Replace these twelve values with that row.

rainfall.source: NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard Public Information Statement, 5 May 2021 (annual 14.25 in). Downtown, not the lot, so the Westside may differ.
rainfall.effectiveFractionSource: Assumption: share of rain that reaches the root zone. Not from MWELO.

plantFactorSource: MWELO plant factor ranges (very low 0-0.1, low 0.1-0.3, moderate 0.4-0.6, high 0.7-1.0). Each species' category is unverified against WUCOLS Region 3; defaults sit inside the range.

none.label: No irrigation
none.source: Rain only: no applied water is counted

wetting.source: Assumption, unverified. A plant is watered over at least the soil around its root ball: 3.5 times the ball diameter across (a 5 gallon ball is about 11 in, so about 3.2 ft across, 8 sq ft; a 15 gallon one 4.7 ft, 17 sq ft), so a young plant is not watered by its tiny canopy area alone. With the first-year boost that comes to roughly 4 gallons a week for a 5 gallon shrub and 9 for a 15 gallon tree in summer, in line with common nursery guidance. Once the canopy is wider than this the canopy area is used.

establishmentSource: Assumption. The brief asks for a configurable period by plant type; these defaults are not from MWELO.

lawn.source: Assumption: high-water cool-season turf. Check WUCOLS Region 3.

budget.source: MWELO: ETAF for residential landscape projects must not exceed 0.55 (special landscape areas excluded).

pollinator.source: Design choice: a month scores each blooming species by its pollinator value, counting at most 3 plants per species so one species cannot dominate.

outputs.spacingSource: Design choice: on-center spacing equals mature width.
